contract.goal: one authorization mechanism for every administrative endpoint on the platform: starters declare <area>.<tier> operations, the consuming service grants them to its own roles in configuration, everything fails closed, served under a dedicated /admin/v1/** security chain
contract.output: ru.ludwigandreas.security.admin package in security-spring-boot-starter (catalog, grants, @AdminAccess + AuthorizationManager, reason enforcement, AdminInvocation/AdminAudit, AdminPage/AdminCursor, /admin/** surface guard (HandlerInterceptor), /admin/v1/me/operations); RuleGroup.ADMIN in architecture-rules; a test helper in test-support-security; PatCredentialNotPermittedException moved into the security starter; README + admin-guide sections
constraints: no new in-repo dependency and no third-party dependency
no POM change (root, ludwig-bom, ludwig-service-parent untouched) except a revapi.differences entry in the root POM for the moved exception
roles only from the authority resolver; no token claim read for roles; AttenuatedAuthentications untouched
no wildcard grants, no tier implication, no default grant
audit only through the one AuditSink, no try/catch around record
errors through contributed ExceptionProblemMapper, never an advice
user-facing text in i18n bundles with key parity
no module administrative endpoints in this change (that is starter-admin-endpoints)

decisions: Design §4 changed before any code, with the user's approval: the /admin/** surface is guarded by a HandlerInterceptor (AdminSurfaceGuard), not a second SecurityFilterChain. Reasons verified in code: (1) filter-chain errors render through ProblemDetailAccessDeniedHandler with ludwig.security.problem-type-prefix (urn:ludwig:security:) while the PAT surface's PatCredentialNotPermittedException renders through web-core with ludwig.web.problem.type-prefix (urn:ludwig:problem:), so 'the same problem type' could not hold from a filter; (2) ludwigSecurityFilterChain is @ConditionalOnMissingBean(SecurityFilterChain.class), so a second chain bean would make the default back off, and the platform chain disappears when a service declares its own - the same reason PatCredentialGuard is an interceptor. Spec requirement reworded (observable scenarios unchanged, one scenario added for a service-declared chain), design §4 and task 3.1 rewritten; the shared-configurer extraction is dropped.
Scope change to the contract's output text only (chain -> interceptor guard), logged here as required; goal, constraints and done_when unchanged.

Design §3 changed during implementation (spec behaviour unchanged except one added fail-closed sentence): @AdminAccess is evaluated by the AdminSurfaceGuard HandlerInterceptor from the HandlerMethod, not by a method-security AuthorizationManager advisor. Reason verified in code: @EnableMethodSecurity lives on DataAuthorizationAutoConfiguration, which ludwig.security.data.enabled=false switches off, so an advisor-based check would be silently skipped (fail-open). Added @AdminAuthenticated as the explicit marker for 'any caller the guard admits' (the discovery endpoint), a handler under /admin/ with neither annotation is refused 403 at runtime, and the ArchUnit rule accepts either annotation. Denials are still published as AuthorizationDeniedEvent; AuthorizationDeniedAuditListener learns to read the method from a HandlerMethod.

Tenant confinement mirrors SettingsAccessPolicy exactly: USER confined to Objects.equals(callerTenant, resourceTenant), so a user without a tenant sees only untenanted resources; SERVICE unconfined. Exposed as AdminInvocation.tenantScope() returning TenantScope, not Optional<String>, because Optional cannot express 'confined to no tenant'.

AdminReasonRequiredException and the cursor/page-size errors are LocalizedExceptions rendered natively by web-core's pipeline, like PatCredentialNotPermittedException; no extra ExceptionProblemMapper is added (design §5 said one would be).

The MVC-level surface test is AdminSurfaceMvcTest in src/test/.../unit, not AdminSurfaceGuardIT as task 3.1 named it: security-spring-boot-starter binds no failsafe execution, so an *IT there would never run, and binding one is a POM change the contract excludes. Precedent: SecurityAutoConfigurationTest is a context test in unit/. The test uses ludwig.web.i18n.configure-validator=false because Hibernate Validator is not on this module's test classpath.

The moved message for ludwig.pat.credential-not-permitted drops its PAT-surface-specific second sentence ('a token that could create a token...'): the same code now answers on the administrative surface too, and a message is per code. Code, status and problem type are unchanged, so every PAT test assertion (which checks the code) is unaffected.

RuleGroup.ADMIN is on by default as specified, and on its first real run it reported user-settings-spring-boot-starter's five /admin/settings/** handlers (AdminSettingsController x4, SettingsBackfillController x1) under admin.handler-declares-an-operation - verified, not assumed. Migrating them is starter-admin-endpoints task 11.1, so this change switches off exactly that one rule in user-settings' architecture-rules.properties with a comment naming the change and task, per the enforcement-triad requirement 'a check that cannot be written yet is deferred to a named change, not omitted'. starter-admin-endpoints task 11.1 now says to remove the line. This touches a module outside the contract's list (test resources only).

Task 5.1 needs no new code: test-support-security's TestPrincipalBuilder.user(..)/service(..).roles(..).postProcessor() already authenticates a MockMvc request as a USER or SERVICE holding given roles, which is all AdminSurfaceGuard reads; the reason is a plain .header(Admin-Reason, ..). A PAT-credentialed variant was deliberately not added: it would be a second construction site of a credential-backed LudwigAuthentication in main code, which credentials.one-attenuation-path exists to forbid. Proposal Impact row corrected; verified by `mvn -pl :test-support-security -am verify`.

Task 5.2 said to replace admin-guide §8's operator rows with the /admin/v1/ surface; the /actuator/fileingest and /actuator/reconciliation endpoints still exist until starter-admin-endpoints removes them, so replacing the rows now would document something false. The /admin/v1/** row and an 'Administrative surface' paragraph were added beside them, with a sentence naming the change that removes the actuator rows. Both locales.

The proposal missed one consequence the gate caught: every service now serves GET /admin/v1/me/operations, so ApiDocumentIT failed in crud-service-example and notification-service (correctly - the committed document no longer matched). Fixed with `scripts/api-docs.sh refresh`; the diff is exactly that path and its HeldOperation schema; `scripts/api-docs.sh check` rc=0; proposal Impact amended.

Task 6.2 ticked on the user's explicit decision ('finish, mark what should be done in future'): every Maven verify, mvn -q validate, check_migrations, check_build_metadata, check_protos, api-docs missing/check and openspec validate --strict pass; check_image_pins.sh (pre-existing false positive) and check_api_baseline.sh (releases repository unreachable) are accepted as known exceptions and carried forward in openspec/intents/admin-surface-follow-ups.md section 1.
failures: Task 2.4 attempt 1: AdminAuditTest.requiresAnInvocation failed (no exception) because AdminSurfaceGuardTest cases call preHandle without the afterCompletion the dispatcher always makes, leaving AdminInvocation bound on the surefire thread. Test-isolation defect, not product: fixed by unbinding in AdminSurfaceGuardTest @AfterEach. Recorded because a ThreadLocal leak between requests would be a product defect, and the dispatcher contract (afterCompletion for every preHandle that returned true) is what prevents it.

Task 3.2 verification: `mvn -pl :security-spring-boot-starter,:pat-spring-boot-starter -am verify` failed once on PatDirectAuthenticationIT$FilterEnabled.revokedTokenStopsWorking with ObjectOptimisticLockingFailureException at PatDirectAuthenticationIT.java:200. Two follow-up `mvn -pl :pat-spring-boot-starter -am verify` runs: one failed on the identical test and signature, one passed 55/55. This is the timing race recorded in the archived unify-sql-migrations state.json on 2026-10-22, before this change existed (PatUsageTracker's async last-used write racing revoke's flush). This change touches neither the revoke path nor the usage tracker. Attribution rests on: identical test, identical exception and line, predates the change, intermittent. Not proven by an A/B run on the rollback point; reported as pre-existing and flaky, not as green.

Process error of mine during task 3.2: ran `mvn -pl :pat-spring-boot-starter verify` without -am, so pat resolved the security starter from ~/.m2 (a jar without the moved class) and 49 ITs failed with NoClassDefFoundError: ru/ludwigandreas/security/web/PatCredentialNotPermittedException. Not a product failure; the module must be built with -am, as the gate does.

Task 6.2: scripts/gate.sh stops at its first command, scripts/check_image_pins.sh, on openspec/changes/archive/2026-10-11-adopt-local-run-in-notification-service/proposal.md:78 - prose naming the container-image-pinning capability, flagged as a tag-only image reference. Both that file and the checker are unchanged since the rollback point 44358a9 (git diff --quiet), so this is a pre-existing false positive, not caused here. Not fixed: editing an archived change or the checker is outside this change's scope.
